name: Split-Field Cover 8 (Quarter-Quarter-Half)
formation: Penny 5-1-5 Front vs 11P Gun 2x2 Boundary Out
coverage: Cover 8 (Field Quarters Match / Boundary Half Trap)

summary.motive: Exploit tendencies against two-high shells by splitting the field coverage: playing Quarters match to the multi-receiver field side and a hard Cover 2 trap to the boundary to intercept quick out-routes.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Boundary trap corner) & BS (Boundary deep half safety)
summary.whyItWorks: Quarterbacks read the pre-snap two-high look and target the boundary receiver on quick outs, unaware that the boundary corner is squatting in Cover 2 while the safety provides deep-half over-the-top support.
summary.failureMode: A double-move (out-and-up) by the boundary receiver if the safety is late getting to deep-half depth.

beats.title: Two-High Shell Disguise Pre-Snap
beats.text: Chris Shula presents a balanced two-high safety shell. The offense expects standard Quarters (Cover 4) coverage across the entire field.

beats.title: Split-Field Rotation: Cover 8 Structure
beats.text: At the snap, Shula runs Cover 8 (Quarter-Quarter-Half): Field side (RCB & FS) plays Match Quarters, while Boundary side rotates to Cover 2 with LCB squatting and BS rolling to deep half.

beats.title: Boundary Corner Trap Triggered
beats.text: The QB throws the quick boundary out to X, expecting the soft off-coverage of Quarters, only to find LCB squatting directly in the flat and stepping in front of the throw.

beats.title: Interception & Pick-Six Down the Sideline
beats.text: LCB secures the interception in full stride, taking it all the way down the boundary sideline for a defensive touchdown.

relations.tell: Two-high pre-snap shell where boundary corner squats in hard flat while boundary safety rolls over top into deep half
